localDrafts.mainTeaching: Risk responses depend on the stated activity and authority. Avoidance stops that activity; mitigation reduces exposure; acceptance retains informed approved exposure; transfer allocates specified consequences. Insurance and service-contract examples are both transfer and can overlap legally; their supplied subtype labels are not independent strategies. Outsourcing does not remove every responsibility.
